title: Lists drawn over text fields, checkboxes and radios
blurb: Five list controls from the ui-feed collection, rebuilt around native elements: a language select on a details of radios, a recycling search that moves the bins, a setlist of buttons drawn as tape, a combobox in a 1990s window and cities chosen with checkboxes, printed in two colours.
question: The picker of a select and the list of a datalist are in the top layer, so how close can a text field and a group of radios or checkboxes get to a select and a combobox while they stay in the canvas?
result: A text field and a group of radios or checkboxes stood in for each select and combobox and stayed in the canvas, with Enter, Escape and the arrow keys added by the control. Copies of the content in a second style drew a white list inside a moving bar and a yellow ink that slips. Nothing here is verified on a phone.
